week.desc: Work-in-progress fork of VIctory: getting an Xbox Series title to render and run on a Windows PC. No game files.
features: - Meshlet culling read its scene buffers as the wrong kind of view, so the world drew almost nothing; fixed.
- Per-draw descriptor tables could run out, after which draws used slots never made for them and the card hung; fixed.
- Light packed by the game's compute shaders was read back through empty copies (sky, probes, fog); fixed for every mip level and layer.
- The fog reconstruction, shadow-mask, hair, blend-shape skinning, fire and several material programs did not translate; fixed.
- Gathers at a named mip level (with and without an offset) read level 0; fixed.
- Implicit-level samples outside pixel shaders produced invalid DXIL in 730 compute programs; fixed.
- Rectangle lists, depth and stencil twins for depth textures written by compute, texture read-backs.
- Waits for memory values, write-watch queries and page queries no longer walk page tables per call.
- Large title buffers get a copy in card memory, with shader writes found by hashing on the card.
- Title memory can be opened as a graphics heap so that buffers are used in place instead of copied (VICTORYINPLACE, first stage only; a probe confirmed the approach on the test GPU).
- The bindless texture queue no longer uploads stale views; the view table no longer grows without bound; the pipeline library is mapped instead of read into memory.
- An intermittent device loss was traced to the pipeline library file being replaced while mapped; fixed.

cool_fox: Leading CGBJ runtime continuation for GTA VI PC - Pareto residency, Wine/Vulkan fixes, FPS unlock, Port 5 CBV
features: - Pareto Memory Residency & 32 GB RAM Support: Adaptive GPU memory residency limits, preventing WDDM paging exhaustion (0x8007000E) on 16–32 GB systems.
- Pipeline & Descriptor Stability:
- VICTORYPIPELINEWAITMS=0 & VICTORYLIBRARYSTORELATER=1 in launchers to eliminate 500 ms frame stalls and 200 ms+ pipeline-library save hitches.
- Panic-safe pipeline worker queue (Pending::makewith) so a failed translation never hangs waiting threads.
- submitsplit dynamic descriptor slot release (list::tablesdone) and aliasof reference pinning (Held guard) to prevent slot exhaustion and use-after-free during async texture aliasing.
- DirectStorage staging buffer cleanup and idle list/upload trimming (VICTORYLISTIDLETRIMS).
- Shader & Ray Tracing Fixes:
- Shader LOD slot fix (leaves unused LOD slots undefined in array texture coordinate queries to pass DXIL validation).
- Wave32 cascade lowering, scoped submerged shader lowering, and dynamic view address buffer indexing (SLOTVIEWADDRESSES) for ray-tracing BVH descriptors.
- Voxel visibility wave64 mask provenance recovery and blendshape pre-dispatch initialization.
- Wine / Proton & DXIL Robustness: Code-generated root signatures for vkd3d-shader, single-latch DXIL loop CFG normalization, and 256 MiB pipeline worker stack.
- Custom Resolution, Scaling & Framerate:

features: The PS5's Zen 2 APU is rated up to ~100–105 °C TjMax and has built-in hardware thermal protection (overheating warning and automatic shutdown well before damage can occur).

However, if your console reaches ~88–90 °C (especially if it already runs at 80–83 °C at stock 30 FPS), it usually points to dust buildup, restricted airflow, or dry/shifted liquid metal on older PS5 Fat units.
Recommended steps if temps are high:
Adjust your fan curve / lower the target temperature via etaHEN / PS5 Fan Control.
Ensure the console has open ventilation and clean the heatsink/fan of dust.
Optionally raise respct (e.g. 55–60) or lower fps in fps.txt to reduce sustained CPU load.

features: - Filter and sort. Sort by name, frame rate, stars or recent commits; filter by tier and graphics card.

- Shader warm-up. Builds the shader cache before the first launch where a project supports it.
- Activity log. Full Git and Cargo output, copyable and exportable. Each job's log is also kept on disk.
- AI-agent access (off by default). Lets an AI agent read logs and, after you confirm, apply a patch and run the project's build. See Agent tools.
- Screenshot mode. Hides names, paths, notes and logs for sharing pictures.
